# Local QR browser bundle

`qr-code.js` contains the browser implementation of `qrcode@1.5.4` and `dijkstrajs@1.0.3`, bundled as ESM. Wallet addresses and authenticator enrollment URIs are encoded locally. No remote QR service or runtime `qrcode` install is required.

The bundle was generated from the npm distributions with esbuild:

```sh
esbuild node_modules/qrcode/lib/browser.js --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --minify --legal-comments=inline --outfile=src/lib/vendor/qr-code.js
```

Retain the license header and `QR-CODE-LICENSE.txt` when updating. `qr-code.d.ts` describes the APIs used by the app. `tests/qr-code.test.mjs` compares wallet and authenticator SVG output with fixtures generated by the upstream 1.5.4 library before bundling.
